title: How Raw Banana Powder is Transforming the Functional Food and Nutraceutical Industry
content_html:
Raw banana powder is becoming a popular functional ingredient for food manufacturers and nutraceutical brands. It is made from dried green bananas and is valued for its resistant starch and fibre content, its neutral taste and its use in gluten-free baking and nutrition products. As a raw banana powder exporter India buyers can work with directly, Tradenest Naturals supplies this ingredient to brands in the USA, UK, Canada, Europe and other markets.

Demand for clean-label foods continues to grow, so product developers are looking for a reliable green banana powder b2b supplier. Understanding specifications, bulk buying factors and documents helps your brand buy with confidence. This guide covers what B2B buyers need to know about sourcing raw banana powder for commercial use.

Raw Banana Powder Price: Direct Answer on What You Get and Who It Is For

Raw banana powder is a fine, creamy-white to light beige powder. It is produced by drying and milling carefully selected green bananas. The drying step removes moisture while keeping the natural starch of the fruit. As a bulk raw banana powder supplier, Tradenest Naturals focuses on consistent particle size and a neutral flavour for industrial processing. Price depends on specification, quantity, packaging and destination, so it is quoted per order.

This ingredient is used across several B2B sectors:

  • Nutraceutical Companies: fibre supplements, capsules and meal replacement shakes.
  • Functional Food Brands: gluten-free flour blends, snacks and breakfast cereals.
  • Infant Nutrition Manufacturers: baby foods and weaning porridges, subject to the buyer's own regulatory review.
  • Bakery & Confectionery Producers: breads, cookies and energy bars, where it helps with moisture retention and adds fibre.

Specifications, MOQ, Packaging, and Lead Time

When you source industrial ingredients, a clear specification keeps production running smoothly. As raw banana powder manufacturers, we share a product specification sheet with every quotation. It sets out the agreed moisture, mesh size and shelf life. Custom particle sizes can be discussed on request. As a buyer, check the microbial limits, such as total plate count, that apply in your market and add them to your brief.

Our commercial terms are simple:

  • Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ): the MOQ is 5 Kg per product. Custom specifications and private label runs are reviewed and confirmed with the quotation.
  • Raw Banana Powder Bulk Packaging: food-grade bags with inner liners, HDPE containers, or stand-up pouches for private label brands.
  • Lead Time: the dispatch date is confirmed with each quotation. It depends on order volume, specification and packaging.

Certifications and Quality Assurance

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. Each batch is cleaned, dried, milled, sieved and inspected against the agreed specification before packing. Packs carry batch details so each shipment can be traced back to its production batch.

If your market or customer needs independent results, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We also provide export documentation support. Before you order, ask your customs broker which documents your country requires, for example a phytosanitary certificate or a certificate of origin. Many importers also ask suppliers for a certificate of analysis and check microbial, heavy metal and pesticide limits for their market. Share this list at the quotation stage so it can be planned with your order.

Pricing Factors and How to Request a Quote

The raw banana powder wholesale price depends on several market and production factors. Knowing these cost drivers helps procurement managers plan their budgets. Key factors include seasonal raw banana availability, particle size, packaging format, any third-party testing and the destination.

Buying larger volumes usually lowers the raw banana powder price per kg, especially on long-term supply contracts. For an accurate quotation, send us your required volume, destination port and specification. You can also request a sample to test in your own formulation before placing a bulk order.
